metadata.packageSourceProvenance: externally supplied; not automatically verified by this driver

timingBoundaries.tick: sum of restore/move/relaxed validation/display mesh public kernel-call durations
timingBoundaries.tickWithTransfer: tick plus positions/normals/indices/grouping bulk getters and grouped-result free
timingBoundaries.observedWall: wall from restore through transfer, including between-stage memory diagnostic reads
timingBoundaries.quality: mesh closure, finite buffers, face count and selected cap placement checked after timers
timingBoundaries.excluded: consumer orchestration, worker queue, rendering, browser presentation and commit quantities/recognition
timingBoundaries.memory: observed arena/WASM/process snapshots; diagnostic reads and JS GC can affect process memory
timingBoundaries.revisited: previously requested offset, including refused requests; not a proven cache hit
